diagnosis: The paired-delta reframe worked exactly as designed: it removed the beta-drift confound that killed wave-1 H3 and exposed the raw economics of vol-target sizing. The m_t=clamp(0.15/sigma21d,.25,1) overlay does NOT produce a positive mean daily increment over the incumbent - the paired delta averages -4.1bp/day in-sample and -11.5bp/day out-of-sample (ann delta-Sharpe -0.75 / -1.46). Every statistical delta gate fails: G2 p=0.102, G3 60/62 combos non-positive, G4 cumulative delta sum -0.749 with all expanding-fold delta Sharpes negative (min -2.665), G5 observed -1.464 under its own null p95 -1.334. The overlay's total-path advantages (OOS Sharpe 1.892 vs incumbent 1.773; maxDD -23.3% vs -38.3%; turnover -862 trades; charter bar TRUE; primary margin +0.119 >= +0.10 TRUE) are purchased ENTIRELY with variance reduction while sacrificing expected return day-by-day. Under the frozen conjunctive claim ('POSITIVE mean daily net-return DELTA surviving all five statistical gates'), this is an unambiguous FAIL - and it falsifies the MECHANISM, not just the statistics: de-risking when realized vol is high systematically gives up positive-expectation days in this universe/window. Verdict FAIL per kill criteria; no threshold nudging, no sigma-window retuning permitted.
